newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-HIBERNIAN SEIZE LATE CUP EQUALISER.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-HIBERNIAN SEIZE LATE CUP EQUALISER.

text.p: Hibernian seized an 83rd minute equaliser against Celtic to force a Scottish Cup fourth round replay after a 1-1 draw on Monday.
Phil O'Donnell fired the Glasgow side ahead after 16 minutes from a pass by Dutchman Pierre Van Hooydonk, and they clung on to the slim advantage until seven minutes from the end.
Hosts Hibernian equalised from a spot kick by Darren Jackson, who had been fouled himself.
The winners of the replay have been drawn at home to Glasgow Rangers in the quarter-finals.
